name: AFR 941 右EGT波动 滑油压力下降 右发失效

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is Air France 941, you are descending through 3900 meters for 3600 meters, contact Wuhan Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是Air France 941，正在从3900米下降至3600米，请联系武汉进近。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR941, leaving 3900 meters for 3600 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，AFR941，离开3900米下降至3600米。

cards.audioText: C: Air France 941, Wuhan Approach, radar identified, information Echo is current, descend to and maintain 3000 meters on QNH 1004.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 941，武汉进近，雷达识别，当前通播为Echo，按QNH 1004下降并保持3000米。
cards.referenceText: Information E, descend to and maintain 3000 meters on QNH 1004, AFR941.

cards.audioText:
C: Air France 941, descend and maintain 2400 meters, reduce to minimum clean speed.
B: Read back the instruction and tell the controller that the clean configuration speed of your aircraft is 200 knots.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 941，下降并保持2400米，减至最小光洁速度。请复诵指令，并告诉管制员你机型的光洁形态速度是200节。
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 2400 meters, reduce to minimum clean speed, our clean configuration speed is 200 knots, AFR941.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持2400米，减至最小光洁速度，我们的光洁形态速度是200节，AFR941。

cards.audioText: C: Air France 941, turn right heading 300, you are number 3, 25 miles from touchdown.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 941，右转航向300，你是第三架，距接地点25海里。

cards.audioText: C: Air France 941, turn left proceed direct Delta Alpha, descend to and maintain 2100 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 941，左转直飞DA，下降并保持2100米。
cards.referenceText: Turn left proceed direct DA, descend to and maintain 2100 meters, AFR941.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转直飞DA，下降并保持2100米，AFR941。

cards.audioText:
C: Air France 941, hold at Delta Alpha as published.
B: Read back and ask the reason for holding.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 941，在DA按公布程序等待。请复诵并询问等待原因。
cards.referenceText: Hold at DA as published, what's the reason for holding? AFR941.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在DA按公布程序等待，请问等待原因？AFR941。

cards.audioText:
C: Air France 941, there are having a runway inspection at the moment, expect to delay more than 15 minutes.
B: Read back the ATC instruction and report that you are entering the hold.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 941，目前正在进行跑道检查，预计延误超过15分钟。请复诵空管指令，并报告你正在进入等待。
cards.referenceText: Roger, we are entering the hold, AFR941.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，我们正在进入等待，AFR941。

cards.audioText: B: The EGT of your starboard engine is fluctuating, state the situation to the controller, ask to leave the holding pattern right away.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的右发排气温度波动，请向管制员说明情况，并申请立即脱离等待程序。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR941, the EGT of our starboard engine is fluctuating, request leave the holding pattern immediately.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，AFR941，我们右发排气温度波动，申请立即脱离等待程序。

cards.audioText:
C: Air France 941, roger, stand by, continue your hold, we're changing the landing sequence, expect call you in 2 minutes.
B: The oil pressure of your starboard engine is rapidly decreasing, state the situation to the controller, request immediate exit and request descent.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 941，收到，请稍等，继续等待。我们正在调整落地顺序，预计2分钟后呼叫你。你的右发滑油压力正在快速下降，请向管制员说明情况，申请立即退出等待并下降。
cards.referenceText: The oil pressure of our starboard engine is rapidly decreasing, request immediate exit and descent, AFR941.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们右发滑油压力正在快速下降，申请立即退出等待并下降，AFR941。

cards.audioText:
C: Air France 941, stand by, a traffic at your 3 o'clock position, is maintaining 1800 meters, crossing from your right to the left, report visual.
B: Tell the controller you have seen the conflicting aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 941，请稍等。你三点钟方向有冲突飞机，保持1800米，从你右侧向左侧穿越，看到请报告。告诉管制员你已看到冲突飞机。

cards.audioText: B: Your starboard engine has failed, make an Urgency call and ask for landing priority.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的右发已经失效，请发出紧急信号并申请优先落地。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Approach, AFR941, our starboard engine has failed, request priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉进近，AFR941，我们右发失效，申请优先落地。

cards.audioText: C: Air France 941, roger PAN, turn left heading 060, descend to 900 meters, cleared ILS approach runway 36L.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 941，收到紧急信号，左转航向060，下降至900米，可以ILS进近36左跑道。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 060, descend to 900 meters, cleared ILS approach runway 36L, AFR941.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向060，下降至900米，可以ILS进近36L，AFR941。

cards.audioText: C: Air France 941, contact Wuhan Tower, frequency 124.35, goodbye.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 941，联系武汉塔台，频率124.35，再见。

cards.audioText: B: Your heading is 060 and your altitude is 900 meters, contact Wuhan Tower and tell him about the condition of the aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh: 你当前航向060，高度900米，请联系武汉塔台并说明飞机状况。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR941, heading 060, 900 meters, our starboard engine has failed, request priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，AFR941，航向060，900米，我们右发失效，申请优先落地。

cards.audioText: C: Roger, Air France 941, maintain present heading.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：收到，Air France 941，保持当前航向。

cards.audioText: C: Air France 941, turn left heading 030 to intercept the localizer for runway 36L.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 941，左转航向030，截获36左跑道航向道。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 030 to intercept the localizer for runway 36L, AFR941.

cards.audioText: B: Report you have established localizer runway 36L.
cards.audioTextZh: 报告你已建立36左跑道航向道。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR941, established localizer runway 36L.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，AFR941，已建立36L航向道。

cards.audioText: C: Air France 941, cleared to land.
